name: Dwellings of Eldervale

categories.label: Points earned during play
categories.help: The score your marker shows on the Victory Point track before end-game scoring.

categories.label: Tableau cards
categories.help: Points from your starter card and Adventure cards, by your Elemental power for each card (up to 3 Adventure cards per Dwelling built).

categories.label: Vaults
categories.help: Points from your Vault cards, as each card describes.

categories.label: Unspent Orbs
categories.help: One point for each Orb you did not spend.

categories.label: Elemental power markers
categories.help: Points equal to the number each of your power markers sits on; a marker off the tracks is worth nothing.

categories.label: Dwellings
categories.help: Points for each Dwelling, by your Elemental power in the Realm where it stands.

categories.label: Prophecy cards
categories.help: Points from prophecy cards still in your hand, as each card describes.

categories.label: Resources and Magic cards
categories.help: Resources plus Magic cards you hold. Scores nothing; the most wins a tie.

source.rulebook_title: Dwellings of Eldervale Rules of Play

notes: Base game only; solo (Ghosts of Eldervale), 2v2 mode, mercenaries, Oracle and mini-expansions excluded. Publisher PDF linked from the Breaking Games product page; it is image-only so it was read via OCR (macOS Vision) and numbers should be verified against the printed book. Player count 2-5 is inferred from setup tables and 5 scoring markers; the rulebook has no explicit player-count line. Rulebook lists six end-game steps; points during play are the marker position before them.
